key_facts: UPDATED July 17 (T+1d to res=2026-07-18; conditional on Rogers permanently leaving Aston Villa in summer 2026): July 17 Ben Jacobs (GiveMeSport) + Evening Standard report initial club-to-club talks have already taken place between Arsenal and Aston Villa, with Arsenal set to table an opening bid for their #1 summer target (unaffected by Christos Tzolis signing from Club Brugge; talks accelerating post-WC after England's July 15 SF loss). July 17 Steve Kay (FootballTransfers) claims personal terms with Arsenal are finalized, Rogers told Villa he wants Arsenal, and Arsenal are preparing a club-record £105m (€123m) first bid — though Villa are expected to knock it back and demand ~£130m (€150m; Villa also sounding out Johan Manzambi). Meanwhile Arsenal cooling on £100m Bruno Guimaraes frees budget headroom. Still NO formal bid accepted, so Arsenal remain strictly capped at 0.50 per anti-overconfidence guardrail. Rival mix shifted: Ben Jacobs July 17 explicitly names 'Manchester United, Chelsea and PSG' as clubs that have looked at Rogers (omitting Liverpool & Man City), while Evening Standard July 17 reports PSG decided to sell Bradley Barcola and Liverpool are targeting Barcola & Djed Spence. Updated: Arsenal 0.50, Chelsea 0.18, Liverpool 0.11 (-0.05), Paris Saint-Germain 0.08 (new top-5 replacing Man City after £116m Elliot Anderson deal), Manchester United 0.06 (+0.01, though signed Andrey Santos + Tielemans & linked with Kone). Outside 0.07 (Man City ~0.03, others ~0.04). Sum=0.93.
